exact_claim_wording: Compound dataset × modality shift degrades predictive and reliability behavior relative to known-domain operation.
The severity and type of degradation depend on modality and transfer direction.
B1 improves compound predictive robustness in three of four primary cells.
Predictive improvement does not guarantee uniform reliability improvement.
No practically notable B1 full-modality target tradeoff was observed.
Simple source mask-specific calibration does not uniformly resolve residual reliability failures.
Target-oracle calibration shows partial recoverability but not source-only deployability.
Evidence does not justify an additional learned reliability model.
